pages.h1: Welcome to the World of Now
h2s: A special message from our CEO, Cem Savas
A story of real estate, real people & real-time software.

Plentific empowers the future of residential real estate by streamlining operations to enrich lives and build stronger communities. Our mission is to drive exceptional value and growth through the most connected and scalable platform in the industry.
Our investors are experts in PropTech
Help us build the future of PropTech
pages.mainText: Welcome to the World of NowWe believe there’s something better than fast: now. Our Property Operations Platform connects owners, operators, service providers and tenants on a single platform — unlocking data-driven insights that drive actions in real-time. We call it the World of Now.A special message from our CEO, Cem SavasIn this video, Cem takes us through the beginnings of Plentific, driven by a vision to revolutionise property management.Cem is highlighting the inspiring journey of Plentific from its inception to its current industry-changing innovative platform and service offering.Don't just take our word for itOur property operations platform is trusted by 100 leading real estate clients and powers 1.7M+ units. See our customersA story of real estate, real people & real-time software.Plentific is the leading AI-powered platform for orchestrating property operations in real time.Built for scale and designed to unify fragmented services, Plentific connects landlords, contractors, service providers, and residents through a single, modular platform. By orchestrating and connecting people, processes, and data, it transforms how housing services are delivered—reducing complexity, increasing accountability, and enabling providers to take control of even the most complex operations.In today’s housing landscape, services are often fragmented and spread across disconnected systems, internal teams, and external contractors. Plentific brings everything together. Its intelligent platform automates core workflows like repairs, inspections, and compliance, whilst real-time data orchestration ensures the right information flows to the right people at the right time enabling faster decisions, real-time collaboration, and measurable performance gains.Designed as a flexible integration layer with open APIs and deep sector expertise, Plentific modernises legacy infrastructure and centralises operational data. With this foundation, housing providers can harness AI and machine learning to unlock predictive insights, prevent issues before they escalate, optimising delivery at every level.From repair diagnostics and resident self-service to workforce coordination and supply chain resilience, Plentific enables fully orchestrated service delivery so that communities can thrive, and housing providers can operate with clarity, agility, and impact.As the housing sector adapts to a rapidly evolving world, Plentific plays a central role in enabling a new era of connected, responsive, and sustainable housing services. By combining cutting-edge technology with a collaborative approach, Plentific empowers providers and partners to co-create scalable, human-centered solutions that shape a better tomorrow. Starting now.Recognised for its multi award-winning innovation and named Best Technology Partner in Housing, Plentific is trusted by over 100 customers and supports the lives of more than 3 million residents and the businesses of more than 5,000 service providers across the UK and Germany.View Our Products One team, five core values.We're humanWe’re diverse and embrace all cultures. We champion each other's successes. We’re open and honest in our communications.We're togetherWe’re humble, we listen to and respect our teammates. We challenge each other, but when a decision is made, we all get behind it and deliver.We’re exceptionalWe bring our A-game. We aim to be the best at what we do. We step outside our boundary. If we recognise something needs to be done, we do it.We’re pragmaticWe’re proactive and considerate in our approach. We value others’ time, as well as our own. We’re positive in our thought process but honest about our limitations.We’re client-centricWe are focussed on delivering the best outcome for our customers. We believe the impossible is possible, through dedication and focus.Plentific empowers the future of residential real estate by streamlining operations to enrich lives and build stronger communities. pages.h1: A New Era for Field Service Management
h2s: From vision to reality: redefining Field Service Management
The next chapter for housing services
pages.mainText: blogA New Era for Field Service ManagementField Service Management is evolving. Plentific shows how connected intelligence turns FSM from a task tool into a strategic foundation for housing services.Watch the video ShareHousing and property operations are at a turning point. Operational complexity is rising, resident expectations are higher than ever, and teams are under pressure to deliver more with less and all while navigating fragmented systems and disconnected data.Cem Savas and Emily Shaw explore why Field Service Management (FSM) must evolve and how connected intelligence is redefining what great service looks like across housing and property operations.This article and the video outline the thinking behind that vision, and why FSM is no longer just an operational capability, but a strategic foundation for a confident digital transformation. From vision to reality: redefining Field Service ManagementThat vision comes to life through Plentific’s Field Service Management solution. As Cem outlines, Plentific FSM delivers intuitive, simplified processes and a truly unified experience across the entire property operations ecosystem.Rather than operating as a standalone tool, FSM is embedded within Plentific’s end-to-end platform connecting resident requests, work orders, field delivery, contractors, supply chain, and performance data in one orchestrated system.This platform-led approach moves FSM beyond task management and positions it as a core enabler of operational transformation.Purpose-built for housingEmily Shaw brings the product perspective, highlighting what sets Plentific FSM apart. It is purpose-built for housing, designed around real-world operational processes, regulatory requirements, and resident expectations.By uniting live data, automation, and AI, Plentific FSM enables providers to move from reactive maintenance to predictive service delivery. Dynamic scheduling uses real-time intelligence to deploy the right resource at the right time improving efficiency for teams and outcomes for residents.Crucially, FSM is built on the same platform used to manage third-party contractors. This creates a consistent experience across in-house teams and external partners, helping balance demand and supply while delivering a seamless, data-led service.The result is a single, intuitive experience for everyone involved:Field operatives benefit from a mobile-first, easy-to-use appOffice teams gain full visibility and controlResidents receive faster updates and greater transparencyThe next chapter for housing servicesAs Cem concludes, this is the next chapter for housing services. Interconnected data, enriched by AI, and designed around people.Plentific FSM is not a standalone tool. It is fully integrated into a complete housing ecosystem, connecting resident experience, field teams, supply chains, and operational insight on one platform.In a world where data, AI, and connected systems define operational excellence, Plentific is proud to lead the change and proud to empower housing providers to act faster, smarter, and with greater confidence.Watch the full conversation with Cem Savas and Emily Shaw to explore how connected Field Service Management is shaping the future of property operations.Share
